verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs describe recorded workflows that "Sai reruns on a schedule." Tasks run in Sai's own cloud VM, so they do not need your laptop open, and work continues after you close it, with iMessage/Telegram notifications when it needs you. Saved workflows replay as code and self-heal when the UI changes, and an approval step gates sensitive actions, which together cover autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how schedules and triggers are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended scheduled runs.
